semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in power and analog chips/modules and integrated circuit packaging substrates using advanced packaging technology.
summary: Shenzhen Zhongke Sihe Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of specialty products in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the development of power and analog chips/modules utilizing Panel-level Fan-out packaging technology. The company also manufactures integrated circuit packaging substrates through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Xiamen Sihe Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
capabilities: Development of power and analog chips/modules based on Panel-level Fan-out packaging technology
Manufacturing of integrated circuit packaging substrates

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen and operates a manufacturing plant in Xiamen.
